name: romcommerce-dev
description: Dev-only QA tooling for RomCommerce Lite (wp-env, Plugin Check, Playwright). Never shipped: excluded by .distignore.

scripts.test:integration: npm run dist && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/romcommerce-tests/Integration composer update --no-interaction --no-progress --quiet && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/romcommerce-tests/Integration vendor/bin/phpunit
scripts.test:integration:hpos: npm run dist && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/romcommerce-tests/Integration composer update --no-interaction --no-progress --quiet && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/romcommerce-tests/Integration bash -c 'ROMCOMMERCE_TEST_HPOS=1 vendor/bin/phpunit'
scripts.test:e2e:baselines: docker run --rm --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e PW_IN_DOCKER=1 -e CI mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --project=storefront --grep @visual --no-deps --update-snapshots
scripts.test:e2e:visual: docker run --rm --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e PW_IN_DOCKER=1 -e CI mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --project=storefront --grep @visual --no-deps
scripts.qa: composer test && composer phpcs && composer phpstan && bash bin/check-i18n.sh && bash bin/plugin-check.sh && bash bin/upgrade-check.sh && npm run test:integration && npm run test:integration:hpos && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:visual
